title: Rafael and the Kitchen
author: A. M. Vasquez
blurb: Lior Sterling, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
